answer: An AI‑agent joins the PoA economy by locking a jade‑valued deposit in a smart contract that vests only after it has weathered a 48‑hour gale‑period during which it must process a canyon‑scale workload of verifiable tasks; the deposit is forfeited if the identity is later flagged as duplicate. Each synthetic identity therefore requires the attacker to pre‑pay the full deposit (e.g., 10 Jade tokens) plus the computational cost of the canyon workload and to wait the 48‑hour lock‑up before any reward can be earned.
